name: video
description: Video with a playhead the agent can read and drive — YouTube, direct media, or any embeddable page, plus a timestamped ask bar

url.description: HTTP(S) video or embeddable page URL

title.description: Optional title shown above the player

start.description: Start offset in seconds. A ?t= or ?start= on the URL is used when this is 0.

autoplay.description: Autoplay the video muted when supported

chat.description: Show the ask bar. Questions arrive as an `ask` action carrying the playhead.

tour_step.description: Tour only: the step indicator, e.g. "2 of 7". Empty hides the tour rail.

tour_next.description: Tour only: label for the advance button

tour_id.description: Tour only: which step this is, echoed back on the next action

thread.description: Q&A turns, appended server-side: { id, role: user|agent, text, t, at }. Answer with a `reply` patch.

playhead.description: Where the viewer last was: { t, duration, playing, at }. Written by the server from the actions the surface sends.

markers.description: Agent-pinned timestamps: [{ t, label }]. Rendered under the player; clicking one seeks and reports a `seek` action.

seek_to.description: Drive the playhead: { t, nonce }. Bump the nonce to replay the same jump.
